# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc = the programme's centre. The empire still holds land in the region.
oe_fs_pc_held = { any_owned_location = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region } }
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. Sparse land of the region (the colonisation line's own test).
oe_fs_pc_sparse = { any_owned_location = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region oe_col_sparse = yes } }
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. The clock stops (design 3.3.2, "war pauses"): a civil war, or a war that touches the
# region (a place of ours there occupied, or bordering a country at war with us).
oe_fs_pc_paused = {
    OR = {
        oe_fs_calm = no
        AND = {
            at_war = yes
            any_owned_location = {
                var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region
                OR = {
                    NOT = { controller ?= c:BYZ }
                    any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Location scope; scope:oe_fs_pc. A fort site (step 3 a): ours and in our hands, on a foreign border, no castle or
# bastion yet. Only land the empire owns is ever touched.
oe_fs_fort_site = {
    var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_fs_pc.var:oe_theme_region
    owner ?= c:BYZ
    controller ?= c:BYZ
    is_border = yes
    NOT = { has_building = building_type:castle }
    NOT = { has_building = building_type:bastion }
}
